name: KITN Rhythm
memo: Rage Against the Machine - Killing in the Name: rhythm. Tom Morello: JCM800 2205 boost channel, tight mid-forward grit, no effects.

band.style_feel: heavy half-time-ish groove, tight kick locked to the riff, open snare/crash on the big chorus hits
band.key: D minor (D Phrygian flavour; analyzers disagree)
parts: Part A: intro riff - sparse, drums and bass lock in
Part B: verse - same riff, restrained groove
Part C: chorus 'Killing in the name of' - full band
Part D: bridge/build 'Some of those that work forces' - rising intensity
Part E: final 'Fuck you I won't do what you tell me' outburst and outro - full on
band.tips: Tempo is about 88-89 BPM (sources vary). Play the main riff cleanly for 2 bars before starting the Trio+ learn pass; keep it tight and steady, since the song is built on repetition.

whammy.tuning: Drop D (D A D G B E)
whammy.when: Solo only (Whammy pedal squeal); riff and verses need no pedal
how: Tune the 6th string down to D (Drop D) by hand; the DT cannot make true Drop D, so do not use DROPTUNE.
Turn the left knob to 2 OCT UP; leave the right knob off.
For the solo, press WHAMMY and rock the pedal heel-toe (or hold MOMENTARY) while playing high notes with the wah.
whammy.tips: Drop D and a Whammy on the solo are confirmed by several sources (Wikipedia, Roland, killerguitarrigs); the exact Whammy setting (2 OCT UP) comes from one source, so adjust by ear (OCT UP is a good alternative).

guitar.position: bridge pickup, volume and tone full up; lower the amp gain a little on a humbucker guitar
guitar.tone_notes: Main riff is Morello's Telecaster in Drop D into a JCM800; a Les Paul is layered on top for overdubs. A single-coil guitar is closest to the main track; a humbucker guitar also works and matches the overdubs. The bridge pickup choice is an informed guess, not a sourced setting.

name: KITN Wah Solo
memo: Killing in the Name: solo. Morello's wah/Whammy-style squeal; wah on the fx slot, boosted lead level, short delay.
